title: Address a Cook in their own grammatical form
objective: Convert every gendered string to an ICU select on the Cook's stored form, so Kafoo stops addressing half its Cooks in the wrong gender. ADR-0010.
acceptance_criteria: the Kitchen Profile conversation asks the fifth question, and the code says why a question that looks like a failure to infer is the right call here
all 56 gendered strings are ICU select in both ARB files, Arabic written first
roughly 56 call sites read the preference through a Riverpod provider; the two Customer-facing strings describing a Cook read the COOK's stored form, not the reader's
the localization parity check is extended to compare placeholders and select branches, not only key presence — the sweep must fix the check, not trust it
notes: EXCLUSIVE because it rewrites both ARB files and ~56 call sites across every feature. Every user-facing package touches the ARBs, so nothing else can run beside it without a merge nobody wants to resolve. It also changes verify.sh, which every other package depends on to know whether it passed. Not split further: converting the strings without the call sites leaves the app broken, and extending the parity check after the conversion means the conversion shipped unchecked.
